tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// saṃshayas+yatamogh+nolkanāmabadz+ra.ak+ṣobh+yikas+yabidhekarmābaraṇ+ḍabishodhanas+yamaritadzīwānudharakaraṇobidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga las sgrib rnam sbyong gi gshin gson rjes 'dzin skabs kyi zur rgyan som nyi'i mun sel sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rnam 'dren gang gi bsgom bzlas bgyis tsam gyis// tshe rabs bsags pa'i las sgrib kun sbyangs nas// bde mchog go 'phang sbyin pa mi 'khrugs pa'i// cho gas gshin gson rjes su 'dzin tshul bri// 'dir rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga las sgrib rnam sbyong gi dogs sel la gsum ste/ gshin po rjes 'dzin dang*/ gson po rjes 'dzin/ mjug phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po la/ nyin gcig pa'i cho gas gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la/ gzhi gtsang mar me tog gis sil ma dgram pa'i steng du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor zhal shar du phyogs par dgram pa'i mthar/ mchod gtor sogs lag len spyi ltar bshams pa'i lho phyogs su sbyong stegs pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du/ tshe 'das kyi ming byang ngam gzugs ris sam rus bu sogs bzhag sbyang chas rnams kyang bshams la/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed cha gsum gtang ba dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba bcas sngon du btang*/ gong du bzlas pa'i tshe/ bye ma'am yungs kar la sngags kyi nus pa bstim la bzhag rten a mṛ tas bsang*/ shū n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nṛ las tshe las 'das pa che ge mo rang gi phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang tshe 'das kyi snying ga'i nṛ las 'od zer 'phros pas tshe 'das kyi rnam shes gang na gnas pa nas bkug zhes brjod cing bsams la/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas te/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba khams gsum skye gnas bzhi rigs drug srid pa bar do gang na gnas kyang skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ a pa nā ya hūm̐ zhes pas rnam par shes pa a thung ngu'i rnam par bkug ste rten la thim pas snying gar a dkar po dri ma med pa'i gzugs su gyur par bsam/ las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma rten la bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nā na na maḥsarba ta thā ga te zhes sogs lan gsum gyis zhi bas sbyang*/ ting lo dang chang bus rten la bskor zhing*/ rdo rje gsor la sum+bha sogs brjod pa lan gsum gyis zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs la/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa dang*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig spro na/ khro bo spyan 'dren nas mchod bstod kyi bar du yang byas la/ gong ltar rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs nas bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa dang*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i rigs gang yin pa de dag la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas/ des tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig

gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar dgas par bya'o// zhes dang*/ rten la gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ drag sngags mang du bzla zhing rol mo drag tu bya ba lan gsum gyis drag pos sbyang*/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad kaṃ yig nag po'i rnam pas sna sgo nas 'thon te sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas til la thim/ de g.yas su me dang g.yon du chur dor bas sdig sgrib bsregs shing sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mer bsregs shing chur dor/ rten la kaṃ ka ni bzla zhing bye ma'am yungs kar gyis brabs la/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog rgyas pa na/ shāka thub nas 'byung ba'i/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces sogs nas/ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+yaka ga te he du na hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa'i bar kun rig skabs ltar brjod cing bye ma'am yungs kar gyis brab bo// mthar che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig ces brjod/ mchog khrus ni/ dkyil 'khor la me long bstan te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas bkru/ de dag sku la sogs sngags dang bcas pas sku phyis la/ chu de bum par blugs te/ rten la dngos sam me long la gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i sogs drug dang*/ chu bo drug gi sogs dang*/ dri chu drug gi sogs dang*/ dri ma rnam drug sogs sh+lau ka re re'i mtshams su/ kaṃ ka ni'i gzungs kyi mthar che ge mo'i sarba pā paṃ bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas bkru ba ste nyung ba la dga' bas de tsam gyis chog spro na/ gzungs sngags kyi mthar tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sogs dang*/

'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug sogs dug gsum gyi dri ma sbyang ba dang*/ sa 'di dug gi pha yin sogs 'byung ba bzhi la brten pa'i dri ma sbyang ba rnams kyang*/ kaṃ ka ni brjod pa ma gtogs kun rig bzhin dang*/ gang la ser sna sogs kyis shis brjod rnams byas na shin tu legs pa zhig 'byung ngo*// kha cig skabs 'dir bar do chos bshad byed pa'i lugs yod pa ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// de ltar na de'i mjug tu yan lag bdun pa bya ba'i yul sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs gsal gdab pa yod pa de dag gi spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas rjes zlos byar gzhug bar do chos bshad mi byed pa ltar na/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ tshe las 'das pa khyed rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum dang*/ gtso bo rgyal ba sogs brjod/ gal te tshe 'das de rang dang chos 'brel med na/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i tshogs zhing de dag gi theg pa chen po'i dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub snying por sogs dang*/ ji ltar sngon gyi sogs lan gsum gsum brjod de/ mjug dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ deng dus bdag tshe sogs dang*/ gzhan dga' ba bsgom pa/ bdag gi de ring skyob pa sogs ni lan re re brjod do// skabs 'dir dbang mi bskur na byang bu bsreg pa'am mi bsreg na lam sbyang bstan sogs bya/ dbang bskur na/ maṇ+ḍal dang rjes zlos kyi rigs rnams tshe 'das des byed par bsams la/

slob dpon gyis nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa snod kyi skyon gsum spangs nas gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rang re rnams kyi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa rnams phyogs ris su bsdu na theg pa chung ngu dang chen po gnyis su 'du la/ theg pa chen po la yang*/ pha rol du phyin pa'i sde snod dang rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sde snod gnyis las 'di phyi ma yin/ de la'ang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi las/ 'dir rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang*/ so so'i rgyud gnyis las/ so so'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud/ pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs/ lngas rtsen gyi rigs/ nor bu'i rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs te drug tu yod pa las/ rdo rje'i rigs yin/ de la rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po/ rigs kyi yum/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/ rigs kyi pho nya'am phyag brnyan pho mo'i rgyud de lnga yod pa'i dang po/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dze tā ri la sogs pa cho ga'i yan lag 'ga' zhig spyod rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba bsgrub pa la/

slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub par byas nas/ khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba'i cho ga la/ 'jug pa dang dbang gi dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang por 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs kyi rgyud dag par byas nas/ sngon chad rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po re byin te/ oṃ tsak+ṣuḥban+dha wā ra ma nā ya hūm̐ zhes pas gdong bcings nas/ lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag rten gyi slad du me tog gi phreng ba re a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas byin nas bum chu gtor te/ oṃ ma mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/ rigs nges par bya ba'i slad du/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ zhes dris pas lan btab par mos te/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags// zhes lan btab nas/ khyed rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu zhig gsal btab ste/

de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa zhig par btab pa bzhin du lam ste byung bar mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis khyed rang gi snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas brtan par byas nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun spyod rnams snod dang mi ldan pa'i mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas/ slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid par mos la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo bo dud tsam dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang skad cig gis rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhig gsal btab ste/ slob dpon la mos gus mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros nas/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ khyed rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas de 'dra ba du ma byung ste khyed rang gi thugs kar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ gzungs ring gi mthar oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya a aḥ zhes mang du brjod pas ye shes phab pa spyi bor rdo rje bzhag pas brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pas brtan par byas nas/ dam rgya spyi bor bzhag ste kaṃ ka ni lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ dkyil 'khor la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor/ yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ nam mkha'i kha dog brtag pa ni/ khyed rnams kyi mig mig ras dang bcas bzhin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la gzigs te mig lam du kha dog gang mthong ba re slob dpon la smra dgos pas/ mig lam la ci snang zhes dri/ dkar po zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ sngon po'am nag po mngon spyod/ ljang gu'am/ khra bo'am/ sna tshogs mthong na las sna tshogs 'grub pa yin no zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor la me tog dbul ba ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du gtso 'khor gyi rnam par bstan pa tsam ma gtogs ngo bo la bzang ngan med mod/ 'on kyang las bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog cig snyam pas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gsung zhing dkyil 'khor la me tog phul zhig ces brjod/

des kyang phul la/ me tog de slob dpon gyis blangs nas khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ pra ti grih+na s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes pas lha la ngo sprad/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzod// phye bas sangs rgyas mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// he badz+ra pa sh+ye/ zhes pas mig ras dang ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs bsal te dkyil 'khor bltar gzhug dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skye// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab// 'gro ba'i phun tshogs dngos grub kyang*// thams cad khyod la mngon du 'gyur// dngos grub phyir ni dam tshig srungs// gsang sngags dag la'ang brtson par gyis// de yang 'di na 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par spyod pa rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ phyi rol du me ri rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing steng thog rim pa gsum du phub pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can gyi dbus su sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang*/ 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang ldan pa'i g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/

lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la shar du pad+ma can dkar mo g.yas dpal be'u 'dzin pa/ lhor 'od ldan ma dmar mo g.yas pad+ma/ nub tu mdangs ldan ma sngon mo g.yas gdugs/ byang dri med ma ljang gu g.yas dung*/ mer 'jigs byed ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo/ srin por rnal 'byor ma sngon mo g.yas rgyal mtshan/ rlung du dkar shang ma dmar skya g.yas bum pa/ dbang ldan du yid gzhungs ma ljang gu g.yas gser nya 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ nu 'bur zung gi mdzes shing lang tsho la bab pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can zla ba la rgyab brten zhing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// zhes sam/ mi nus na/ shar du pad+ma can dkar mo nas/ dbang ldan du yid gzhungs ma ljang gu ste thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa ni/ brtan pa lha ste/ mdor na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor pa dang mngon sum lta bur mjal snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa zhes sogs kyis bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ de'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/

g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun du dung la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor te yod par mos/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i gang ba thogs te khyed rang gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ kaṃ ka ni'i rjes su oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag nas/ bdag nyid rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i skur gyur pa brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tod+bha wā ya swā hā zhes cod paṇa gyis dbang bskur nas/ de la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs kyis mchod pa ni bya rgyud kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi'o// de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang*/ zhes sdom pa bzung ba khas blangs nas dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod rnams slob dpon la 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas sogs lan gsum brjod/ de rnams kyi sgo nas las sgrib thams cad rnam par sbyong ba rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa zhu/

tshe 'das la dbang bskur bas lhar gyur pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a k+ṣo bh+ya ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la// zhes pas bstod/ dbang ma bskur na/ tshe las 'das pa skad cig gis rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs kar a yig gis mtshan par gyur pa bsams la/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ zas gtad byed na/ 'dod yon rnams la chab kyis bran te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos mchod gnas lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med byang chub thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a k+ṣo bh+ya ru pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ sgra dri ro reg bya rnams la'ang shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+ṣe sogs bsgyur te 'bul la/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod sogs brjod/ byang bu bsreg pa la 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ dbang bskur bas tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa de'am/ yang na a dkar po'i rnam par yar nam mkha' la gnas par mos shing*/ de nas phyi nang gi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes pa'i ngang nas/ 'khrul ngor snang ba'i tshe 'das kyis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsregs shing sbyong du rung ba dpe bud shing dang chos mtshungs su gnas pa'i ming byang ngam gzugs kyi rnam pa can du gnas pa de/ slob dpon gyis chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar shes pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ye shes kyi me dang chos mtshungs su gnas pa des bsregs shing sbyangs pas/

'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa ye shes kyi snang ba chen por 'bar bar mos te/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes// tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa// ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig /ces dang*/ kaṃ ka ni brjod cing bsreg go /lam sbyang bstan ni/ nub gong ma rnams la mchod pa'i rjes dang*/ nub tha ma la byang bu bsregs pa'i rjes la bya ste/ dril bu gsil zhing me tog gtor la/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyi// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang bsgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas// 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+ne rat+na saṃ bha we/ rat+na ki ra ṇi rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing*/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i rnam par gnas pa de'am/ a dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam pa can de shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs kar thim par bsams la rol mo bya'o// pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i// srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i// mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma ud+bha we ma hā a bhi nan+daṃ gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mngon dga'i zhing du sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang dbyer med du 'dres te/ slar yang de'i thugs ka nas byung ste mdun gyi pad+ma'i sbubs su brdzus te skyes par bsams la rol mo bya'o// spro na de'i mthar mchod pa sogs kun rig ltar byed na/ des kyang rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod zhes pa tsam ma gtogs 'dra/

dkyil chog dkyus su/ gshin po rjes 'dzin rgyas pa la mos na/ rtsa rig gi tshab kaṃ ka nis bya ba dang*/ lha'i mtshan bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs cho ga gzhan rnams gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi lho sgo'i skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin byas pas rung ngo zhes gsungs pa'i don to// gang ltar yang tshe 'das kyi don du/ 'di nas nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /dag pa'i zhing khams mngon dga' ru// pad+ma'i snying po dam pa la// brdzus te skye ba len par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i zhing*// zhes sogs kyis smon lam ci shes bya zhing bdag med pa'i lta ba'i rgyas gdab bo// 'di dag ni gshin po rjes 'dzin kho na gtso bor byas pa yin no// gnyis pa gson po rjes 'dzin te/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus su ni phyir bzlog dang bcas pa byed na/ gong gi sbyong ba nas brtsams te mchog khrus dman khrus kyi bar ram/ gang la ser sna sogs kyi shis brjod yan chad dang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul gong ltar gsal btab nas/ gtso bo rgyal ba sogs kyi tshe/ tshe 'das zhes pa'i tshab tu bdag cag dang bdag gi zhes pa kha bsgyur te rjes zlos byar gzhug go /'ga' zhig skabs 'dir sdig sbyang gi ched du gson byang bsreg pa la mos pa ltar na/ shog bu la kaṃ yig nag po la sbyin bdag gi ming tshe dang ldan pa che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad zhes bris pa mdun du bzhag la/ slar yang sdig pa sbyang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa smin mtshams nas thon te/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas mar zhugs lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa sman pa mkhas pas skyugs sman btang ba bzhin du/

sna bug dang kha sgo ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nag nyil gyis thon te/ mdun gyi kaṃ yig nag po de nyid la thim par mos te/ kaṃ yig de nyid khyed rang gi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa bsregs shing sbyong du rung ba sogs gong byang bu bsregs pa'i skabs ltar brda sprad la/ slob dpon gyis dpal 'bar thogs te/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes// tshe ldan sgrib pa'i bud shing sogs dang*/ kaṃ ka ni bzla zhing*/ kaṃ yig bsregs la/ sbyang bya'i sdig pa/ sbyong byed kyi thabs/ sbyong ba po'i gang zag ste/ 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa spros bral sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i rgyas gdab bo// ming byang bsregs pa'i ro ma de sa gtsang sar dor bar bya'o// de dag ni phyir bzlog gi rim pa'o// de dang 'brel ba'am ma 'brel kyang rung ste/ dbang bskur byed na/ dngos gzhi nyin gcig ma ltar na/ gong sems bskyed gsal btab pa nas bzung ste/ dngos gzhi'i mjug oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod pa ni/ bya rgyud kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi'o zhes pa yan chad sngar bzhin gyi mthar/ mtha' rten la gnod pa zhi ba'i ched du bkru byab bsrung gsum bya ba dang*/ shis pa bya ba'i phyir bkra shis rdzas brgyad sbyin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon bkra shis kyi lha mo rnams dang lhan cig pas bum pa thogs te/ khrus gsol bas bum pa'i chus lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab ste sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byas pa mos te/ khyed rang rnams la khrus gsol bar mos pa mdzod/ kaṃ ka ni sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog ces sogs dang*/ oṃ maṅga la shrī dzad+ma dza swā hā/ de bzhin du/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ pad+ma྾ /'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba chu yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// ts+tsha traṃ ga྾

'di ni tshul khrims྾ /khrims 'chal dri ma྾ /tshul khrims chu yis྾ /khrus legs mdzad྾ /shaṃ kha྾ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang྾ /khong khro'i dri ma྾ /bzod pa dri yis྾ /khrus legs mdzad la྾ /tsakra྾ 'di ni brtson 'grus྾ /le lo'i dri ma྾ /brtson 'grus chu yis྾ /khrus legs mdzad la྾ /dh+wa dza྾ 'di ni bsam gtan྾ /rnam g.yeng dri ma྾ /bsam gtan dri yis྾ /khrus legs mdzad la྾ /ka la sha྾ 'di ni shes rab྾ /shes 'chal dri ma྾ /shes rab dri yis྾ /khrus legs mdzad la྾ /nya tsha྾ zhes pa rnams lan gcig sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyis sarba pā paṃ

sdig pa thams cad zhi ba'i gzhi tshugs/ bh+yaḥshīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sarba bgegs thams cad/ bigh+ne྾ sarba nad thams cad/ ro ge྾ sarba sdang ba thams cad/ duṣ+ṭe྾ sarba gza' thams cad/ gra he྾ sarba dz+nyā rims thams cad/ re྾ sarba byā gdung ba thams cad/ dhi྾ sarba u pa nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad/ dra be྾ sarba a kā la dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad/ mṛ t+yū྾ sarba dur+sawa rmi lam ngan pa thams cad/ p+ni྾ sarba mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad/ durmī te྾ sarba tsi ta ci yang rung ba'i rigs thams cad zhi ba'i gzhi tshugs/ ku le bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas bkrus te/ byab pa ni/ khar chu cung zad bzung la rma bya'i sgro'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsams te/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sgros lus la byabs pas nad rims gdon bgegs thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags len pa ltar blangs nas phyir dor bar mos te/ gzungs kyi mthar rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sarba pā paṃ bh+yaḥ.a pa nā ya swā hā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang sbyar te byab/ sdig sgrib skyugs par bsams la kha'i chu snod du pho'o// bsrung ba ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su rdo rjes reg pa la brten nas/ de las de 'dra ba'i rigs can bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung bas lus la rdo rje'i go gyon te bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par byas snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gzungs kyi mthar rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes dang*/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sarba pā paṃ bh+yaḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes sogs sbyar la/ spyi bo mdun rgyab dpung mgo gnyis/ pus mo gnyis te gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pas bsrung ngo*// shis par bya ba'i slad du bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams la bum chu gtor te/ bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ maṃ ga la aṣ+ṭa dra be hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ rim pa bzhin du byin la/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas sogs nas/ bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog /ces dang*/ slar yang de dag brtan par bya ba'i ched du/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs kyis bkra shis mdor bsdus brjod la/ rdo rje slob ma rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod/ dbang gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs kyis dam tshig bsdus te khas blangs nas/ dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus dang longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dengs nas brtsams te sogs brjod de/ slob ma rang gnas su gtang*/ rjes chog gi mchod pa kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs pa sogs dkyus ltar byas pas grub bo// gal te sta gon dang dngos gzhi nyin gnyis pa byed na cho ga'i dkyus nas 'byung ba ji lta ba bzhin bdag bskyed sngon du btang nas/ sa lha sta gon dang*/ lha sta gon dang*/ bum pa sta gon grub nas/ slob ma sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad nas slob ma rnams bos te 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal gdab pa sogs bshad pa dkyus ltar bya zhing*/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i slad du so shing sbyin pa'i skabs/ bum chu gtor zhing bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo me tog gi cod paṇa dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

zhes dang*/ a mṛ tas byin gyis brlabs pa'i so shing thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du sngags de nyid kyis sbyin te/ so brud pa bzhin byas pas sdig sgrib thams cad skyugs par bsams la/ so shing gi rwa ba tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i dbus su cang mi smra bar dor cig de yang rtse mo rang ngam steng du phyogs na mchog gi dngos grub/ shar du phyogs na 'bring gi dngos grub/ phyogs mtshams gzhan rnams su phyogs na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub/ 'og tu phyogs na sa 'og gi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro// sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyang ba'i slad du khyor chu blud pa ni/ a mṛ te bzlas pa'i chu oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsaṃ s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpā na a pa na ya hūm̐ zhes lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i khyor chu sngags de nyid kyis lan gsum sbyin no// bar chad bsrung ba'i slad du srung skud sbyin pa ni/ srung skud las bum chus gtor zhing bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung skud dmar po rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi lus tshad dang mnyam pa rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btab pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te dam tshig srad bu la thim zhes byin gyis brlabs pa'i srung skud de nyid/ slob ma skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas par gtso bo'i sngags bzla zhing bcings la/ bum chu gtor/ yig brgyas brtan par bya'o// rtswa ku sha'i sngas stan sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i phon po che chung gnyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥdang ha las byung ba'i ku sha che chung gnyis rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

ces dang*/ dhīḥha bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ ku sha che ba g.yas su dhīḥdang*/ chung ba g.yon du ha bzlas pas sbyin no// chos zab mo bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /ces sogs brjod/ de'i don ni/ 'jig rten na u dum wā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar sogs nas/ 'di'i dngos gzhi sang nyin 'byung ba yin no zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar dang*/ rjes kyi cho ga rnams dkyus ltar bya'o// dngos gzhi'i cho ga sgrub pa dkyus ltar dang*/ brda sprod kyi 'gor sems bskyed gsal gdab nas/ 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba la/ 'jug sgo mang du yod pa las/ 'dir 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyang ba'i gzungs kyi cho ga bgyid pa la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la sta gon gyi rim pa rnams khar sang gi gnas skabs su song zin/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs nas dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po sogs gong gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi skabs ltar brjod pas grub bo// gsum pa mjug phan yon bstan pa ni/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs las/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pā ra ṇi me swā hā/ gzungs sngags 'di'i cho ga ni 'di yin te/ rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro// dus gsum du bzlas brjod byas na mtshams med pa lnga yang byang bar 'gyur ro// lan gcig bzlas brjod byas na ltas ngan pa dang bkra mi shes pa rnams med par 'gyur ro// lus la 'chang ngam glegs bam la bris nas mgul du thogs te 'chang na dus ma yin par 'chi ba rnams gtan du 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// gang zhig snying rjes non te ri dwags dang*/

bya dang*/ mi dang*/ mi ma yin pa rnams kyang rung ste 'chi ba'i rna khung du brjod na de ngan song du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro// yang na shi ste dus las 'das na shi 'phos pa'i ming nas smos te de'i phyir byams pa dang snying rjes lan brgya'am stong ngam 'bum brjod na de sems can dmyal bar skyes su zin kyang de'i mod la thar bar 'gyur ro// sa'am til lam yungs kar ram chu gang yang rung ba la bzlas brjod byas te/ shi ba'i lus la gtor ram/ khrus byas nas de'i 'og tu 'chad pa'am/ yang na mchod rten gyi nang du bcug ste bzhag la/ rig sngags kyang bris nas mgo la btags na/ de ngan song du skyes pa yang zhag bdun gyis gdon mi za bar thar te/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ba'am/ yang na rang gi smon lam gyi dbang gis skye bar 'gyur ro// gang zhig zla ba nya ba'i tshe khrus byas la gtsang mar byas te/ dus gsum du gos brje zhing kha zas mi bza' ba'am/ yang na kha zas dkar bag bza' zhing*/ sku gdung dang mchod rten du gang gi ming dang ldan pas lan 'bum bzlas brjod byas na de ngan song nas thar te gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i ris su skyes nas sgrub pa po'i thad du 'ongs te mchod par byed lus kyang ston la/ legs so zhes bya ba yang byin nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te mi snang bar 'gyur ro// de'i ming bris la gzungs sngags bzlas brjod byed cing mchod rten 'bum byas la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas legs par mchod nas rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ yang na chu klung du btang na des sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa nas thar bar 'gyur ro// zhes 'di'i gzungs sngags bzlas brjod sogs byas pa tsam gyis phan yon de ltar 'byung ba bshad na/ 'di'i sgrub pa'i thabs dang gzungs kyi cho ga dbang bskur ba la sogs pa tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i tshul shes par byas nas skal ba dang ldan pas nyams su blang ba la shin tu 'bad par bya'o// smras pa/

bya rgyud rdo rje rigs kyi mi 'khrugs pa'i// cho ga las sgrib rnam par sbyong ba'i skabs// gshin gson rjes su 'dzin pa'i khyad chos kyi// som nyi'i mun pa 'phrog pa'i sgron ma byas// 'dis kyang rgyal ba gnyis pa e waṃ pa// yab sras bzhed gzhung 'khrul rtog gis dben pa// sprin bral nyi ma'i 'od bzhin ches gsal bas// 'gro ba'i las sgrib sbyong ba'i mthu ldan shog /ces kun mkhyen dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga las sgrib rnam sbyong gi gshin gson rjes 'dzin skabs kyi zur rgyan som nyi'i mun sel sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lha rgyal srang gi bla ma rab dkar lhun grub dang sangs rgyas grags pa rnam gnyis gsung gis bskul ngor ban+de ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung me zla'i lcags yos kyi zhag gi phung po khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes dge bar lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab grags pa'i mu khyud kyi bsti gnas su bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dpal ldan bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon po dang*// dbyer med lhag pa'i lha der gus btud de// rmi ngan bzlog dang 'chi ba bslu ba'i phyir// zab mo'i gdams pa 'dri la gnang ba stsol// de'ang 'dir dbang dus su rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa dang*/ thun mong du 'chi ba bslu ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i sangs rgyas spyan ma/ skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum gyis bskor nas bzhugs pa la/ skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ sems bskyed spyi ltar lan gsum byas la/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang dang bsrung bya dbyer med pa'i sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge laṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ lus phyi nang gi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs nas dri ma med pa'i 'od du gyur/

de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gis pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas 'khor lo'i lte bar mig gi 'bras bus mtshan pa dang*/ g.yon gdan la brten cing sdong po'i rtser pad+ma dkar po'i dbus na mig gi 'bras bu yod pa 'dzin pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba kha sbyor gyi bar du rang gzhan don gyi tshe rang dang bsrung bya'i zhes brjod/ gi ming yig yod pa'i phyi nas/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha lo tsa ne sarba ar+tha sā dha ne swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis rgya gram du dkris pas/ dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs par bsrung bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru nas swā hā/ zhes pa gtso bor bzla zhing*/ mjug tu sngags de'i swā hā'i gong du sarba a ka la mṛ t+yuṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzlas mthar/ spyan gyis 'khor lo mdzes ma ste// 'chi ba slong bar byed pa'i mchog /bdag cag sdug bsngal nyen pa la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ rlung bum pa can ci rigs par bsgom/ bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas spyan mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal te/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyis rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas spyan ma 'grub gyur sogs nas/ sa la 'god par shog lo brgya thub cing ston brgya sogs bkra shis bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// brtse chen snying po'i thugs kyi bum bzang las// 'chi med ring 'tshor sbyin pa'i zil dngar 'di// 'dren mchog gong ma'i gsung don gsal phyir bris// dge bas 'gro ba'i dal rten ring 'tshor shog
/ces sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sgrub thabs 'di'ang tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
